fresh box: no config · run 'caramelo commander init' to name this machine
59 commands are hidden here; 'caramelo manual --role all' lists every command
of every role.

COMMANDS
    caramelo commander            The machine you type on: name it and write the files it needs
      caramelo commander init     Name this machine a commander and write the files it needs
    caramelo context              Say where this CLI is running and what a command typed here would act on
    caramelo hub                  Commands the machine itself runs: setup, uninstall, status, run
      caramelo hub setup          Turn this machine into a Caramelo host (run as root)
      caramelo hub status         Report what setup installed on this machine and whether it is running
      caramelo hub uninstall      Stop caramelod and undo what setup changed on this machine (run as root)
    caramelo manual               The manual of this machine: every command that holds here, with examples
    caramelo task                 The tasks this binary carries: what they do and running one here
      caramelo task list          List the tasks this binary carries
      caramelo task run           Run a task on this machine
      caramelo task show          Print the task file that will run, byte for byte
    caramelo version              Print the caramelo version
